events.title: Cursor cloud agents become an always-on system — event Subscriptions, VM-isolated subagents, /goal, non-interrupt steering
events.title_zh: Cursor 云端 agent 升级为常驻系统——事件订阅、VM 隔离 subagent、/goal、免打断引导
events.published_at_note: Official changelog entry dated Aug 19, 2026 at cursor.com/changelog/08-19-26 (per-entry page shows 'Aug 19, 2026 · Changelog'). In-window. Cloud subagents themselves predate this (cloud environment setup + cloud subagents shipped ~2026-06-17); what is new on 8/19 is the always-on/event-driven system layer.
events.summary: Cursor shipped a release that turns cloud agents from on-demand sessions into an always-on system that 'operates as a system, building and shipping software on their own'. New primitives: (1) Subscriptions — a cloud agent subscribes to an event source (a PR, a Slack thread, a schedule) and wakes when something happens; cloud agents automatically subscribe to PRs they create and drive them to completion, fixing CI and addressing bot comments; available for cloud agents only for now. (2) Custom modes — any skill can be pinned as an always-on 'custom mode' in chat. (3) Subagents on their own machines — each subagent runs on its own virtual machine with an isolated copy of the project and clean context; supports swarm patterns ('run a swarm of subagents to test my app for bugs, each in its own environment'). (4) /goal — give the agent a long-lived objective worked toward until fully complete, pairable with custom modes and /loop. (5) Steering improvements — follow-up messages wait for the next tool call instead of interrupting the agent mid-action.
events.why_it_matters: This is the most complete commercial packaging so far of the always-on multi-agent runtime pattern: event-driven wake-up, VM-per-subagent isolation for clean-context parallel work, long-lived goals, and non-interrupt steering are exactly the primitives an autonomous coding fleet needs. The auto-subscribed, PR-driving agent closes the loop with Cursor's own hosting (Origin) and CI integrations, meaning one vendor now covers repo → review → CI → always-on agents. Caution: it deepens lock-in to Cursor's cloud stack, swarm parallelism has real compute cost, and autonomous PR-driving agents need guardrails before pointing at production repositories.

events.title: PTXBench: benchmarking and adapting LLMs for architecture-specific PTX GPU kernel optimization (arXiv 2608.17379)
events.title_zh: PTXBench：面向特定架构 PTX GPU kernel 优化的 LLM 评测与适配（arXiv 2608.17379）
events.published_at_note: v1 submitted 2026-08-18T05:14:41Z; announced in the Wed, 19 Aug 2026 arXiv cs.CL digest (in-window). Authors: Genghan Zhang, Yixin Dong, Chengze Fan, Zhichen Zeng, Yueming Yuan, Shaowei Zhu.
events.summary: PTXBench is a benchmark for evaluating and adapting LLMs to use architecture-specific PTX (NVIDIA's low-level IR) for GPU kernel optimization. It measures three things across GEMM and attention workloads on H100 and B200: functional correctness, whether the selected target instructions actually execute at runtime, and speedup over frontier libraries (e.g. cuBLAS/cuDNN-class). Findings: architecture-specific PTX capability is uneven — success rates fall sharply on complex attention-backward workloads, and executing the target instructions does not translate into competitive performance (no evaluated model consistently matches frontier libraries). The authors also adapt Qwen3.6-27B via SFT: repair-conditioned training improves several tasks, but generalization remains uneven; data coverage, balance and reasoning-teacher quality matter beyond dataset size. PTXBench positions itself as an auditable testbed for measuring and improving LLMs' ability to exploit evolving GPU architectures.
events.why_it_matters: Kernel generation is where LLMs could compound the hardest (hardware refreshes every year, kernel engineers scarce), and this is one of the first benchmarks to go below CUDA to architecture-specific PTX on both H100 and B200, with runtime verification that claimed instructions actually execute. The negative result is the actionable part: today's models can emit exotic instructions without beating tuned libraries, so kernel-agent pipelines should verify speedup, not instruction selection, as their success signal. Extends the KB's GPU-kernel-with-LLMs evidence line (ev-20260813-06, contract-grade verifier) from verification toward capability measurement.
events.summary_zh: PTXBench 是一个评估和改造 LLM 使用架构特定 PTX（NVIDIA 底层 IR）做 GPU kernel 优化的 benchmark。它在 H100 与 B200 上针对 GEMM 和 attention 负载度量三件事：功能正确性、选定的目标指令是否真的在运行时执行、相对前沿库（cuBLAS/cuDNN 级别）的加速比。结论：架构特定 PTX 能力参差——复杂 attention backward 负载上成功率显著下降，且目标指令被执行并不等于性能有竞争力（没有任何被测模型能稳定追平前沿库）。作者还用 SFT 改造 Qwen3.6-27B：repair-conditioned 训练改进了若干任务，但泛化仍不均匀；除数据规模外，数据覆盖度、平衡性与 reasoning teacher 质量同样关键。PTXBench 定位为度量并改进 LLM 利用演进 GPU 架构能力的可审计 testbed。

PTXBench positions itself as an auditable testbed for measuring and improving LLMs' ability to exploit evolving GPU architectures.
events.why_it_matters_zh: Kernel 生成是 LLM 可能产生最大复利效应的领域（硬件每年刷新、kernel 工程师稀缺），而这是首批下探到架构特定 PTX、并同时覆盖 H100 与 B200 的 benchmark 之一，且带运行时验证（声称的指令是否真的执行）。最有行动价值的是负结果：当前模型能输出特殊指令却不敌调优库——kernel-agent 流水线应把「加速比」而非「指令选择」作为成功信号。与本知识库 GPU-kernel×LLM 证据线（ev-20260813-06 contract-grade verifier）形成衔接：从验证走向能力度量。

events.title: Aggregate benchmark scores conceal item-level regressions in commercial LLM API migrations (arXiv 2608.17719)
events.title_zh: 聚合 benchmark 分数会掩盖商用 LLM API 迁移中的条目级回退（arXiv 2608.17719）
events.published_at_note: v1 submitted 2026-08-18T12:44:54Z; announced in the Wed, 19 Aug 2026 arXiv cs.CL digest (in-window). Authors: Xiaonan Xu, Wenjing Wu. Complete response-level archive and per-item scoring outputs released per the abstract.
events.summary: An empirical software-engineering study of what aggregate benchmark scores hide during commercial LLM API migrations. Method: three pairwise upgrades in the GPT-5.4 → GPT-5.6 Sol product sequence; 900 public benchmark items (graduate-level knowledge, olympiad mathematics, instruction following) queried 50 times per item per model; each item classified as reliably improved, reliably regressed, practically equivalent, or inconclusive under false-discovery-rate control and a practical-significance threshold, calibrated against a label-permutation null. Results: across all nine migration-benchmark cells, reliable improvements and reliable regressions coexist — upgrade edges with aggregate gains of up to 7.3 percentage points still contain up to 8.3% reliably regressed items, and edges with aggregate losses contain up to 10.7% reliably improved items. On instruction following, the strict-vs-loose scoring gap widens by 3.9 points on the latest migration (a 3.9-point regression under strict scoring shrinks to 0.04 under loose). The complete response-level archive and per-item scoring outputs are released.
events.why_it_matters: Every team on a commercial LLM API faces forced migrations when vendors deprecate models; this paper turns 'aggregate scores look fine' into a measured, reproducible warning: net-positive upgrades ship double-digit percentages of reliably regressed behaviors, and scoring strictness alone can make a regression disappear. The methodology (per-item repeated sampling + FDR control + practical-significance thresholds, with a released archive) is directly reusable as a migration acceptance gate — more useful to API consumers than another leaderboard.
events.summary_zh: 一项针对商业 LLM API 迁移中聚合 benchmark 分数掩盖现象的实证软件工程研究。方法：GPT-5.4 → GPT-5.6 Sol 产品序列的三次成对升级；900 个公开 benchmark 条目（研究生级知识、奥数、instruction following），每条目每模型查询 50 次；在 false-discovery-rate 控制与实际显著性阈值下将每条目分类为可靠改进、可靠回退、实际等价或不确定，并用 label-permutation 空值校准。结果：全部九个迁移-benchmark 单元中，可靠改进与可靠回退并存——聚合增益最高 7.3 个百分点的升级边中仍含至多 8.3% 的可靠回退条目；聚合损失的边中也有至多 10.7% 的可靠改进条目。Instruction following 上，最新迁移的严格/宽松评分差距扩大 3.9 个百分点（严格口径下 3.9 点的回退在宽松口径下缩至 0.04）。完整 response-level 归档与逐条目评分输出已发布。

Method: three pairwise upgrades in the GPT-5.4 → GPT-5.6 Sol product sequence; 900 public benchmark items (graduate-level knowledge, olympiad mathematics, instruction following) queried 50 times per item per model; each item classified as reliably improved, reliably regressed, practically equivalent, or inconclusive under false-discovery-rate control and a practical-significance threshold, calibrated against a label-permutation null. Results: across all nine migration-benchmark cells, reliable improvements and reliable regressions coexist — upgrade edges with aggregate gains of up to 7.3 percentage points still contain up to 8.3% reliably regressed items, and edges with aggregate losses contain up to 10.7% reliably improved items. On instruction following, the strict-vs-loose scoring gap widens by 3.9 points on the latest migration (a 3.9-point regression under strict scoring shrinks to 0.04 under loose). The complete response-level archive and per-item scoring outputs are released.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 所有使用商业 LLM API 的团队都会遇到厂商弃用模型后的被迫迁移；本文把「聚合分数看起来没问题」变成可度量、可复现的警告：净收益为正的升级仍会带来两位数百分比的可靠行为回退，而评分口径的宽严就能让回退消失。其方法（逐条目重复采样 + FDR 控制 + 实际显著性阈值 + 归档发布）可直接复用为迁移验收门禁——对 API 使用方比对又一个 leaderboard 有用得多。
